response.sql: SELECT sc.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_matched_records FROM scanconservation AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction_of_matched_records DESC, s.insurstat NULLS LAST, sc.zoneref LIMIT 10;
